content:
We need to propose a retrosynthesis route up to 5 steps, leaves must be commercially available, total price <= $9999. Need to output JSON tree with reactions and molecules.

We have target SMILES: O[C@H]1C[C@@H](O[C@@H]([C@@H]1C)/C=C(CO)/C)C/C=C/C=C/C(O)=O

Looks like a polyol with an ether linking a cyclohexane to a polyene chain ending with carboxylic acid. Possibly derived from a simpler diol and a polyene acid.

We have a template 38653 which does a retro-ether formation: breaks C-O ether to give an alkene and an alcohol? The retro template: [C:1]/[CH;D2;+0:2]=[CH;D2;+0:3]/[C:4]>>[C:1]-[C@@H;D3;+0:2]1-O-[C@H;D3;+0:3]-1-[C:4]

So forward: forms an ether ring from an alkene and an alcohol? Actually retro: product is alkene (C=C) with substituents, reactants are cyclic ether with side chain.

Applying to target gave two possible precursors: both are similar: C/C(=C/[C@H]1O[C@@H](C/C=C/[C@@H]2O[C@H]2C(=O)O)C[C@H](O)[C@H]1C)CO and another with C[C@@H]2O[C@H]2/C=C/C(=O)O.

So the disconnection yields a precursor that still contains an ether ring and a carboxylic acid side chain.

We may need further steps: maybe break the other ether similarly.

Let's apply template 38653 again to the precursor to see further disconnections.
